attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: weather_report_generation
steps:
  - id: fetch_weather_data
    op: api_call
    params:
      service: weather_api
      endpoint: /current
      method: GET
      query_params:
        city: "{{ trigger.city }}"
      cache: false
    output: raw_weather_data

  - id: format_weather_report
    op: transform
    params:
      input: "{{ raw_weather_data }}"
      template: |
        Weather Report for {{ raw_weather_data.city }}, {{ raw_weather_data.country }}
        -----------------------------------------------
        Temperature: {{ raw_weather_data.temperature_c }}°C / {{ raw_weather_data.temperature_f }}°F
        Conditions: {{ raw_weather_data.conditions }}
        Humidity: {{ raw_weather_data.humidity }}%
        Wind: {{ raw_weather_data.wind_speed_kph }} km/h {{ raw_weather_data.wind_direction }}
        Visibility: {{ raw_weather_data.visibility_km }} km
        Observed at: {{ raw_weather_data.observation_time }}
    output: weather_report
